lines.en: : I know what I must do.
lines.zh: : 我知道我必须做什么。
: 等等！别开枪！

lines.en: : This isn’t that kind of game!
lines.zh: : 这不是那种游戏！

lines.en: : Who are you and what are you doing in my house?
lines.zh: : 你是谁，在我家里做什么？

lines.en: : We’ve come to stop you from destroying everything you love and ultimately ushering in the start of Chapter 4.
lines.zh: : 我们是来阻止你毁掉你所爱的一切，并最终开启第四章的。

lines.en: : Put the gun down, Sensei. You don’t need to do this.
lines.zh: : 把枪放下，Sensei。你不必这么做。

lines.en: : Why should I trust you? I never gave you a key.
lines.zh: : 我凭什么相信你？我可从没给过你钥匙。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it be fair to assume that we just...got our hands on one the same way you just got your hands on like fifty of them?
lines.zh: : 不如这么想——我们能弄到一把，就跟你能一口气弄到五十把一样，不是理所当然吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know what you’re talking about. But I’m going to give you ten seconds to get out of my house before I open fire.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。不过我给你十秒钟，在我开枪之前滚出我家。
: Sensei！等等！
: Ami？

lines.en: : Okay, you can shoot now. I just wanted to make sure I had a front row seat.
lines.zh: : 好了，你现在可以开枪了。我只是想确认自己能坐到第一排。

lines.en: : Hey! How come you remember Ami but not us? We’re just as important to the story as she is!
lines.zh: : 喂！为什么你记得 Ami 却不记得我们？我们对这个故事来说跟她一样重要！
: Ami，这些人是谁？

lines.en: : Ayane and Maya. They’re your arch-nemeses and your current mission is to eliminate them by any means possible.
lines.zh: : Ayane 和 Maya。她们是你的头号宿敌，而你当前的任务是不惜一切手段把她们消灭掉。
: Ami，你这个叛徒！

lines.en: : We’re in for a long day, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 今天有得熬了，是吧？

lines.en: : Wait a second. If you’re Ami, why are you covered in mosaics?
lines.zh: : 等等。你要真是 Ami，为什么全身打满了马赛克？

lines.en: : I’m not! You’re just imagining that I am!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！那是你自己的想象！

lines.en: : I can’t trust any of you.
lines.zh: : 你们谁我都信不过。
: {i}啊啊啊！我要离开这儿！{/i}

lines.en: : Sensei! Stop shooting! You don’t understand what-
lines.zh: : Sensei！别开枪了！你不明白——
: 啊啊！
: {i}行吧。我走了。{/i}

lines.en: : Maya, wait! We’re supposed to stick together!
lines.zh: : Maya，等等！我们应该并肩作战的！
所以外面{i}真的{/i}很危险。

lines.en: I shouldn’t have opened the door.
lines.zh: 我就不该打开那扇门。

lines.en: I manage to make it to the city streets with my life still intact, but I know that everyone is against me now. And I will stop at nothing to ensure my safety.
lines.zh: 我总算保住小命，来到了城市街道上，但我知道现在所有人都与我为敌。而为了确保自身安全，我不惜一切代价。

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei. Have you calmed down yet?
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei。你冷静下来了吗？

lines.en: : That was crazy, right? It really felt like you were trying to shoot me back there.
lines.zh: : 刚才真是疯了，对吧？我真觉得你是想朝我开枪来着。

lines.en: : Something still seems off about you...
lines.zh: : 你身上还是有点不对劲……

lines.en: : Again, you’re probably just imagining it. But that doesn’t matter right now. What {i}does{/i} matter is giving you a quick mission briefing so we can get you to the roof on time!
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，那大概只是你的想象。不过现在不重要。{i}真正{/i}重要的是给你做个简单的任务简报，好让我们准时把你送到屋顶！

lines.en: : You escaped the safety room, so that’s where you’re headed next, right?
lines.zh: : 你从安全屋逃出来了，所以下一站就是那儿，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m headed nowhere in particular. I just want to enjoy my freedom.
lines.zh: : 我哪儿也不去。我只想享受我的自由。

lines.en: : Well, if you’re looking for suggestions on {i}how{/i} to enjoy that freedom, why not pay the rest of the girls a visit?
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是你想听听{i}怎么{/i}享受这份自由的建议，不如去看看其他姑娘们？

lines.en: : You’ve been gone for a really long time and we’ve all been waiting for you to come back, so I took the liberty of putting together a kind of...card! Of sorts.
lines.zh: : 你离开了太久，大家都在等你回来，所以我自作主张做了个……算是卡片之类的东西！
: 卡片？

lines.en: : Yeah. I had everybody come up with a list of the things they like most about you because I thought hearing it would make you happy.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我让每个人都列了一张“最喜欢你哪一点”的清单，因为我觉得你听了会开心。

lines.en: : The thing is, though, not everybody has processed your disappearance as well as I have. So most of them are broken now.
lines.zh: : 不过问题是，不是每个人都像我这样消化了你的消失。所以她们大多数现在都坏掉了。
: 怎么个坏法？

lines.en: : Well, basically, they think they’re in the card. And that this city’s made of paper.
lines.zh: : 嗯，基本上，她们以为自己在那张卡片里。还以为这座城市是纸做的。

lines.en: : You’re trying to trick me again, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你又在耍我，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course not! I would never-
lines.zh: : 当然不是！我绝不会——

lines.en: : Wait. Did I say “never?” I meant-
lines.zh: : 等等。我刚才说“绝不会”了吗？我是想说——
{i}Ami Arakawa 已被淘汰。{/i}
{i}还剩十九名学生。{/i}
: 剩不了多久了……
下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Hm? My favorite thing about Sensei? Gosh...where do I even begin?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我最喜欢 Sensei 哪一点？天哪……从哪儿说起好呢？

lines.en: : At first, I thought he was just, like...normal. Just your average hot teacher without anything really remarkable about him.
lines.zh: : 一开始，我以为他……就是个普通人。普普通通的帅老师，没什么特别出众的地方。

lines.en: : But as I got to know him a little better, I realized how nice he can really be when he stops acting all mysterious and quiet.
lines.zh: : 可随着我慢慢了解他，我发现只要他不摆出那副神秘兮兮、沉默寡言的样子，人是真的很好。

lines.en: : My sister loves him too. And obviously, that’s a huge plus.
lines.zh: : 我姐姐也喜欢他。这显然是个巨大的加分项。

lines.en: : Apart from Yumi, the two of us have been alone for years now. And I’d be lying if I said that wasn’t really hard at times.
lines.zh: : 除了 Yumi，我们姐妹俩已经孤独了好多年。要说这有时候不难，那我是在撒谎。

lines.en: : Having him around, even if it’s not as often as I’d like it to be, has been a total game changer.
lines.zh: : 有他在身边——哪怕不如我希望的那么频繁——也彻底改变了一切。
: 不过……

lines.en: : I think the thing I like the most is that I know he’d never do anything to purposely hurt me.
lines.zh: : 我想我最喜欢的一点是，我知道他绝不会故意伤害我。
{i}Chika Chosokabe 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Seriously? I really have to do this shit? But I barely even like the guy. Fuck do I care about some stupid ass card?
lines.zh: : 不是吧？我还真得干这种破事？可我压根就不怎么喜欢那家伙。我他妈的在乎什么蠢卡片？

lines.en: : We all know he’s probably just gonna jerk off on it or something.
lines.zh: : 谁都知道，他大概会拿它来打飞机什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t fuckin’ know. I guess if I, like...absolutely {i}had{/i} to pick something...it would be that he hasn’t ever really given up on me. And that’s pretty fuckin’ rare when it comes to me.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的不知道。要是非……{i}非{/i}要我挑一样的话……那就是他从来没真的放弃过我。而对我来说，这他妈的相当罕见。

lines.en: : Shitty part is that “not giving up on me” leads to him basically being a fuckin’ stalker half the time.
lines.zh: : 操蛋的是，这份“不放弃我”有一半时间让他变成了个他妈的跟踪狂。

lines.en: : That shit’s creepy as fuck and it’d be really fuckin’ cool if he could give it a rest sometime soon.
lines.zh: : 那副德行诡异得要死，要是他能早点消停点，那才真的他妈的谢天谢地。
{i}Yumi Yamaguchi 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : It’s kind of...hard to...put how I feel into words, but...I’ll...I’ll try my best...
lines.zh: : 有点……难以……用语言表达我的感受，不过……我……我会尽力的……
: Sensei 是……我……他就像……嗯……

lines.en: : He’s not like...family or...anything like that, but...I think we...have a...kind of...special relationship?...
lines.zh: : 他不像……家人或者……类似的关系，不过……我觉得我们……有某种……特别的关系？……

lines.en: : I don’t...really look up to him, since...he’s...not a good person, but...I...
lines.zh: : 我……并不真的崇拜他，因为……他……不是个好人，可是……我……

lines.en: : When I’m with him...I feel kind of like...like that’s...where I belong...or something...
lines.zh: : 跟他在一起的时候……我会有种感觉……好像那……就是我的归宿……之类的……
: 这……听起来很怪吧？……确实很怪……对吧？……

lines.en: : Let me...Let me start over...I’ll...this time will...be better...
lines.zh: : 让我……让我重来一次……这次……会好一点的……

lines.en: : Sensei is...kind of like...well, it...it feels like I’ve known him...a lot longer than...I actually have...
lines.zh: : Sensei 有点像……嗯，就是……感觉我认识他的时间……比我实际认识的要长得多……
: 而我……那并不……我……

lines.en: : I still...want to spend more time with him...
lines.zh: : 我还是……想多跟他待在一起……
{i}Sana Sakakibara 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Hahah! It would probably be easier to name all of the things he does that annoy me. But, for the sake of the card, I’m sure I can come up with something...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！大概列举他让我恼火的地方反而更容易。不过为了这张卡片，我相信我总能想出点什么……

lines.en: : Sensei...for better or worse, carries my life in his hands. And he’s yet to do anything to {i}really{/i} let me down.
lines.zh: : Sensei……不管好坏，我的命都握在他手里。而他至今还没做过任何{i}真正{/i}让我失望的事。

lines.en: : Yes, he’s full of disappointments. But I understand that some of his tendencies are a direct result of things that he’s had to endure in the past.
lines.zh: : 没错，他确实让人失望的地方不少。但我明白，他的某些脾性是他过去不得不承受的那些事直接造成的。

lines.en: : I hadn’t experienced true hardship until recently. And I understand how that can change a person now.
lines.zh: : 我也是最近才真正体会到艰难。现在我也明白了，那种事能怎样改变一个人。

lines.en: : So, if anything, I think he’s doing a great job as my mentor. Even {i}if{/i} it seems like he’s trying to actively sabotage my future sometimes.
lines.zh: : 所以，要说的话，我觉得他作为我的导师干得非常出色。{i}即便{/i}有时候看起来他像是在主动毁我的前程。

lines.en: : At the end of the day, I don’t think I’d be able to live without him.
lines.zh: : 说到底，我觉得没有他我活不下去。
{i}Makoto Miyamura 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : I like his wiener! It’s all big and veiny and fun to squeeze. Oh, and that thing he does with his fingers where he starts goin’ all fast once you’re about to-
lines.zh: : 我喜欢他的小香肠！又大又青筋暴起，捏起来特别好玩。哦，还有他用手指做的那件事，就是等你快要——的时候突然加速——

lines.en: : Wait, you’re tellin’ me that ain’t allowed on the card? Crud.
lines.zh: : 等等，你是说这不能写在卡片上？糟糕。

lines.en: : I can think of plenty of stuff, don’t worry! That was just the first thing that came to mind since it’s a pretty new development thingy for me.
lines.zh: : 别担心，我能想出来的多着呢！刚才只是第一个冒出来的念头，因为这对我来说还是挺新鲜的事儿。

lines.en: : For actual stuff I like about Sensei, though...
lines.zh: : 要说真正喜欢 Sensei 的地方呢……

lines.en: : I think it’s cool that he accepts me for who I am. Or who I’m...currently being or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 我觉得他很酷，能接纳真实的我。或者说……接纳我现在正在成为的那个我？

lines.en: : I don’t really know myself yet. I’m still tryin’ to figure out who the real Miku Maruyama is. And I like that Sensei doesn’t really pressure me into makin’ any big decisions before I’m ready for ‘em.
lines.zh: : 我自己都还不太了解自己。我还在琢磨真正的 Miku Maruyama 是什么样的人。而我喜欢 Sensei 不会在我准备好之前逼我做什么重大决定。

lines.en: : Except for all those times he got a little too touchy before I was cool with that. But I’m super cool with it now, so-
lines.zh: : 除了那些次我还没同意他就毛手毛脚的时候。不过现在我已经完全 OK 了，所以——
{i}Miku Maruyama 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : How long am I allowed to make this thingy? Like, is it cool if I do a whole essay or- really? A few sentences? Hmm...that makes it kinda tough.
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿我能写多长？比如，我写篇完整的作文行不行——真的？就几句话？嗯……那可有点难办了。

lines.en: : If you’re really gonna make me narrow it down, I’d probably start off by saying that I’ve never really had any close guy friends before. So he’s my first. And he’s so good at it that I don’t think I’ll ever need another.
lines.zh: : 要是真让我精简一下，我大概会先说，我以前从没有过亲密的男性朋友。所以他是第一个。而他做得太好了，我觉得我永远都不需要第二个。

lines.en: : We’ve had our ups and downs for sure. But I feel like you kind of {i}need{/i} to drive over a few bumps in the road if you’re ever {i}really{/i} gonna bond with somebody, you know?
lines.zh: : 我们当然有过起起落落。不过我觉得，要想{i}真正{/i}跟一个人交心，你多少{i}得{/i}在路上颠几下，你懂吧？

lines.en: : It’s those hardships that strengthen the connection you have. And no matter what he does or what I do to mess things up, we always find our way back to each other.
lines.zh: : 正是那些坎坷让你们之间的羁绊更牢固。而且不管他做了什么、或者我把事情搞得多糟，我们总能找到回到彼此身边的路。

lines.en: : So...yeah. I don’t think I’ll ever have another friend like him. And I’m not just saying that because he’s twice my age and also pretty much my dad.
lines.zh: : 所以……嗯。我觉得我再也交不到像他这样的朋友了。而且我这话不只是因为他年纪是我两倍大、基本算我爸。
{i}Rin Rokuhara 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : A card?...Of course I’d be willing to write something. Sensei’s done so much for me since becoming my teacher and- oh! Sorry, I should probably be jotting this down, shouldn’t I?
lines.zh: : 卡片？……我当然愿意写点什么。Sensei 从成为我的老师以来为我做了那么多——啊！抱歉，我大概该把它记下来才对吧？

lines.en: : Let’s see...the easy answer would be to talk about what he’s done for my confidence. And how his constant reassurances always make me smile even if I can’t bring myself to fully believe them.
lines.zh: : 让我想想……最简单的答案，是说说他为我建立自信做了什么。还有他那不断的鼓励，总是让我忍不住微笑，哪怕我没法完全相信那些话。

lines.en: : But I think the thing I like the most is...hahah...it sounds kind of silly and embarrassing to say it out loud, but...
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得我最喜欢的一点是……哈哈哈……说出来有点傻，也有点难为情，可是……

lines.en: : I like the way he looks at me.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢他看我的方式。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if it’s just because of the bond we’ve built together or if it’s a little more complicated than that, but...sometimes, I don’t realize just {i}how long{/i} our eyes stay locked on one another’s.
lines.zh: : 我不确定这仅仅是因为我们之间建立的羁绊，还是比那更复杂一些，不过……有时候，我没意识到我们的目光{i}究竟{/i}交缠了多久。

lines.en: : Then, when I realize, I have to drag myself back to reality and tell myself that this isn’t just another one of my daydreams.
lines.zh: : 等回过神来，我得把自己拽回现实，告诉自己这不是我的又一场白日梦。

lines.en: : This is a {i}real{/i} person, who’s actively choosing to look into {i}my{/i} eyes when it would be so easy to find another pair somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 这是一个{i}真实的{/i}人，他明明可以在别处轻易找到另一双眼睛，却主动选择凝视{i}我的{/i}眼睛。
: 我觉得这真的很特别。
{i}Futaba Fukuyama 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？
{i}还剩一名学生——Ayane Amamiya{/i}

lines.en: {i}She can be found in the dojo.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她在道场里。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Would you like to go there now?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}要现在过去吗？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Are you sure? This action can not be-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你确定吗？此操作无法——{/i}

lines.en: : I will kill her and complete my mission.
lines.zh: : 我会杀了她，完成我的任务。

lines.en: {i}If you are certain this is the path you wish to take, please confirm your decision in the following pop-up menu:{/i}
lines.zh: {i}如果你确定要走这条路，请在接下来的弹出菜单中确认你的决定：{/i}
杀掉 Ayane。完成你的任务。

lines.en: : What I like most about Sensei? Everything, obviously! And if you think that’s just a cop-out answer...I choose everything again!
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢 Sensei 哪一点？当然是全部！你要是觉得这只是敷衍的答案……那我再选一次全部！

lines.en: : Even his worst qualities are amazing to me. And I can’t imagine a life, infinite or not, where I’m not by his side every step of the way.
lines.zh: : 哪怕他最糟糕的缺点，在我眼里也很棒。我无法想象任何一种人生——无论是否无限——不是每一步都陪在他身边的。

lines.en: : Hmm...what else...what else? Can I say “everything” a third time? Or is that starting to push it?
lines.zh: : 嗯……还有什么呢……还有什么呢？我能第三次说“全部”吗？还是说这样有点过分了？

lines.en: : You know what? Let’s throw a third everything in before I start getting slightly more specific and a lot more sentimental.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？在我开始稍微具体一点、也煽情得多之前，先来第三个“全部”吧。

lines.en: : I’m not related to Sensei. I don’t have that sort of special bond with him. And yeah, I’ve known him for a while, but there are some people who have known him even longer that I can’t really compete with.
lines.zh: : 我跟 Sensei 没有血缘关系。我和他之间也没有那种特殊的羁绊。没错，我认识他有一阵子了，可有的人才认识他更久，我真的比不了。

lines.en: : I haven’t chased him across Paper City for years on end or endured apocalypse after apocalypse in hopes that he’ll start to regain some of the memories we’ve made together.
lines.zh: : 我没有长年累月地追着他穿过纸城，也没有经历一次又一次的末日，只为盼着他能重新拾起我们一起留下的那些记忆。

lines.en: : In fact, I haven’t really done anything other than just...follow him around.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我除了……跟在他身边，什么也没做。

lines.en: : But I don’t think that matters.
lines.zh: : 可我觉得这并不重要。

lines.en: : I don’t think you can really quantify love with some words on a card and...I think the idea of even {i}verbalizing{/i} feelings as strong as the ones I have for him wouldn’t do them any justice.
lines.zh: : 我觉得爱是没法用卡片上的几句话来量化的……而且我觉得，把我对他这么强烈的感情{i}说出口{/i}，本身就无法公正地对待它们。
: 所以我选择全部。

lines.en: : That’s why I’ll always choose everything.
lines.zh: : 所以我永远都会选择全部。

lines.en: : And there’s nothing you can do to stop me.
lines.zh: : 而你们谁也阻止不了我。
: 你为什么还不去死？！

lines.en: : I literally just told you that. There’s nothing you can do to stop me.
lines.zh: : 我刚才明明说过了。你什么都阻止不了。

lines.en: : I need to kill you to finish my mission!
lines.zh: : 我得杀了你才能完成任务！

lines.en: : And what do you get for finishing your mission, Sensei? Is there some sort of reward?
lines.zh: : 那完成任务你能得到什么，Sensei？有什么奖励吗？
: 我不知道。

lines.en: : You mean you’ve been running around massacring the entire class for no reason whatsoever? That’s really mean.
lines.zh: : 你是说，你毫无理由地到处屠杀了全班同学？这可真过分。
: 我到底怎么了？……

lines.en: : What’s happening is your future wife is coming to the rescue once again. So we can leave this place {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 事情的经过是，你未来的老婆又一次来救你了。这样我们就能{i}一起{/i}离开这个地方。

lines.en: : We’re not allowed to leave Paper City. This {i}is{/i} the world outside the walls. I was {i}safe.{/i} I was {i}free{/i} inside of my box. I had everything I’d ever need.
lines.zh: : 我们不许离开纸城。这里{i}就是{/i}墙外的世界。在我的盒子里，我是{i}安全的{/i}。我是{i}自由的{/i}。我拥有我可能需要的一切。

lines.en: : But you didn’t have me, did you?
lines.zh: : 可你没有我，对吧？

lines.en: : Maybe Maya and Ami are both wrong and {i}I’m{/i} actually the main heroine? That’d sure be a twist, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 也许 Maya 和 Ami 都错了，{i}我{/i}才是真正的女主角？那可真是神展开，不是吗？

lines.en: : Come back to the safe house with me. There’s still a coconut crab. I can make hot pot for us.
lines.zh: : 跟我回安全屋吧。还有一只椰子蟹呢。我可以给我们做火锅。

lines.en: : There is no safe house, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 没有什么安全屋，Sensei。
: 有的……
: 也没有什么纸城。
: 明明就有！
: 什么都没有。
: 我们不在任何地方。
: {i}我们一起看四季更迭吧。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m sorry, {i}what{/i} are you asking me to do?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你让我做{i}什么{/i}？
: 我最喜欢 Sensei 哪一点？
: 这简单。
: 什么都没有。
{i}Maya Makinami 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : My favorite thing about the Supreme Overlord? But why would- wait! Don’t tell me! This is for some big finale-style montage scene, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢至尊霸主哪一点？可为什么——等等！别告诉我！这是要给那种压轴大结尾的蒙太奇场景用的，对吧？

lines.en: : Say no more! My favorite thing about Sir would have to be his...compassion? Guilt? Though, I’m not quite sure of how to describe what I mean without making it sound like an insult.
lines.zh: : 不用多说了！我最喜欢大人哪一点，一定是他的……同情心？愧疚感？不过我不太确定该怎么说才不至于听着像在骂人。

lines.en: : Ah! Look at it this way — have you ever gone into a choice-based game and thought to yourself “I’m going to be a real arsehole this playthrough” only to pull the plug like, four choices later?
lines.zh: : 啊！换个说法——你有没有在玩选择向游戏时跟自己说“这周目我要当个彻头彻尾的混蛋”，结果才选了四个选项就受不了关游戏了？

lines.en: : I feel like that’s the boat Sir is in. I think, somewhere along the lines, he decided to play the bad guy. But now, he’s too deep into the playthrough to change his alignment and is just trudging through reluctantly.
lines.zh: : 我觉得大人现在就是这种处境。我想，他大概在某个节点上决定要扮演反派。可现在他在这个周目里陷得太深，改不了阵营了，只能不情不愿地硬着头皮走下去。

lines.en: : I don’t think he gets any real enjoyment out of making evil decisions. In fact, if anything, I admire his perseverance. Tons of people just turn off the game if it ever gets too hard.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他做那些邪恶的决定时，并没有真的乐在其中。事实上，要说的话，我钦佩他的毅力。很多人只要游戏一变难就直接关掉了。

lines.en: : Sir’s the type to complete his mission no matter what. Even if it hurts him. And I think that’s a really cool quality for a person to have.
lines.zh: : 大人是不管怎样都会完成任务的那类人。哪怕那会伤到他自己。我觉得这是一个人身上非常酷的品质。
{i}Molly MacCormack 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please let me know if you have any questions about-
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。如果您对——有任何疑问，请告诉我。

lines.en: : Yes. I can provide feedback in regard to his character. But it will be {i}honest{/i} feedback as I believe all reviews should be as truthful as possible.
lines.zh: : 可以。关于他的品性，我可以提供评价。不过那会是{i}诚实{/i}的评价，因为我认为一切点评都应当尽可能真实。

lines.en: : The Supreme Overlord has a complex flavor profile that only those with experienced tongues and distinguished palates can understand.
lines.zh: : 至尊霸主有着复杂的风味层次，只有舌头老练、味蕾高雅的人才能体会。

lines.en: : He is unlike anyone else to ever come through these doors. And even if his taste is not specifically suited to my liking, I understand that all it may take to fix him is a little bit of salt.
lines.zh: : 他与走进这扇门的任何人都不同。即便他的味道并不特别合我的口味，我也明白，要让他变得恰到好处，也许只需要一点点盐。

lines.en: : What I mean is that he’s almost there. Almost {i}finished.{/i} Which makes watching him very exciting.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，他快到位了。几乎{i}成了{/i}。这让看着他变成了一件非常令人兴奋的事。
{i}Tsuneyo Tojo 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Mmm...normally, I try to stay away from stuff like this. But if it’s for Sensei, I guess I can make an exception.
lines.zh: : 嗯……平时我是尽量躲开这种事的。不过如果是为了 Sensei，我想我可以破个例。

lines.en: : It’s not like he hasn’t already heard all of this from me, though. So...not really sure what you’re trying to get out of just having it on a card, but here you go.
lines.zh: : 再说这些话他早就听我说过了。所以……我不太明白把它写在卡片上有什么意义，不过给你就是了。

lines.en: : The thing I like most about Sensei is how willing he is to put up with my endless barrage of problems and annoyances and that he’s yet to try and get rid of me for having them!
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢 Sensei 的一点是，他多么愿意忍受我那没完没了的问题和烦人之处，而且从未因为我这些毛病而试图甩掉我！

lines.en: : And yes, I know it’s kind of selfish to have my favorite thing about him be more about {i}me{/i} by proxy, but honesty hasn’t failed me yet and I’d really rather not stoop to petty lies to make myself look better.
lines.zh: : 是的，我知道我最喜欢他的地方其实拐弯抹角是在说{i}我自己{/i}，这有点自私，可诚实从没让我失望过，我也实在不想为了让自己好看点而说些无聊的谎。

lines.en: : Oh, and if I’m allowed to choose a second thing about him, I like the way he squeezes my hand when he holds it. It’s kind of weirdly comforting in a way that’s hard to describe.
lines.zh: : 哦，如果还能再选一条的话，我喜欢他牵我的手时握紧的感觉。那有种难以形容的、奇异的安心感。

lines.en: : I wish he’d do it more often.
lines.zh: : 真希望他能多握几次。
{i}Io Ichimonji 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Hm? My favorite thing about Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我最喜欢 Sensei 哪一点？

lines.en: : His wallet, obviously! Thanks to him, I never have to worry about paying extra for guac because it’s always comin’ outta his paycheck!
lines.zh: : 当然是他的钱包！多亏了他，我从来不用担心加牛油果酱要多付钱，因为那都是从他工资里出的！

lines.en: : In all seriousness though, I like his...how do I put this...unpredictability?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，我喜欢他的……怎么说呢……不可预测性？

lines.en: : I feel like he’s always right there when I need him or...want him to be. And it’s gotten to the point where I can’t help but laugh to myself about it because it just seems way too convenient most of the time.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，每当我需要他、或者……希望他在的时候，他就总在那儿。以至于我忍不住自己偷笑，因为大多数时候这都太巧了。

lines.en: : Actually, can you even really {i}call{/i} it unpredictability if it keeps happening? Because there’s gotta be a certain point where the unexpected just...{i}becomes{/i} the expected, right?
lines.zh: : 说真的，如果它一直发生，那还能{i}叫{/i}不可预测吗？总有一个节点，意料之外就……{i}变成{/i}了意料之中，对吧？

lines.en: : And maybe that’s where I’m at with him. I don’t know- it probably sounds weird. But I like being able to count on him being there even when I never go out of my way to summon him.
lines.zh: : 也许我跟他之间就是这种状态。我不知道——听着可能有点怪。但我喜欢这样：哪怕我从没特意叫他来，我也知道他一定会在。

lines.en: : It’s...a relief, I guess. Having someone to fall back on who can distract me from the rest of the world before I even know I want to be distracted.
lines.zh: : 这大概……是一种安心。有个人可以依靠，在我还没意识到自己想逃避之前，就把我的注意力从这世界的其他部分引开。
{i}Uta Ushibori 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Yeah, I can think of something for a card. When do you need it by?
lines.zh: : 嗯，卡片的话我能想到点东西。你什么时候要？

lines.en: : Wait, right now? Isn’t that kind of short notice?
lines.zh: : 等等，就现在？是不是太赶了点？

lines.en: : Then, uhh...I guess I...like that I can talk to him a little differently than I can talk to other adults. And I don’t mean that in a weird way this time.
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……我想我……喜欢我能用跟其他大人不太一样的方式跟他说话。这次我没有别的意思。

lines.en: : Sensei’s a weird dude. And he’s all sorts of fucked up. But I feel like he’s got a really interesting and distinct world view that makes it easy to open up to him when you don’t have anybody else.
lines.zh: : Sensei 是个怪人。而且他一身都是毛病。可我觉得他有着非常有趣又独到的世界观，让你在没有别人可以依靠时，很容易对他敞开心扉。

lines.en: : We’ve joked about it before, but I’m not really sure if he realizes just how much he feels like a brother to me. And, as an only child, I’ve always wanted someone like that.
lines.zh: : 这事我们以前也开过玩笑，可我不太确定他有没有意识到，他对我来说有多像哥哥。而作为独生女，我一直想要一个这样的人。

lines.en: : I just wish he’d stop making so many stupid fucking decisions.
lines.zh: : 我只希望他能少做点他妈的蠢决定。
{i}Otoha Okakura 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : My favorite thing would have to be his {i}mind{/i} of course. It’s so beautifully twisted that simply conversing with him is like climbing up the Enigma of Desire.
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢的一点是他的{i}头脑{/i}，当然。它扭曲得如此美妙，光是跟他交谈，就像是在攀登《欲望之谜》。

lines.en: : Being near him makes me {i}think.{/i} And I very much enjoy thinking. {i}Especially{/i} when those thoughts don’t directly lead me toward some sort of conclusion.
lines.zh: : 待在他身边让我{i}思考{/i}。而我非常享受思考。{i}尤其{/i}是当那些思绪不会直接把我引向某种结论的时候。

lines.en: : As you may have realized by now, I am very smart. And there are few questions I don’t know how to answer. But when it comes to all things pertaining to {i}him,{/i} it feels as if all I can do is guess.
lines.zh: : 你可能已经看出来了，我非常聪明。很少有我不知道怎么回答的问题。可一旦涉及{i}他{/i}的一切，我却好像只能靠猜。

lines.en: : It remains to be seen whether my guessing will {i}lead{/i} to anything...but what I know for sure is I like watching him.
lines.zh: : 我的猜测究竟会不会{i}引向{/i}什么，还有待观察……但我能确定的是，我喜欢看着他。

lines.en: : I wonder if he likes watching me?
lines.zh: : 不知道他喜不喜欢看着我呢？
{i}Nodoka Nagasawa 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Oh, what a splendid idea! I love things like this. I’m sure he’ll be delighted.
lines.zh: : 哦，多妙的主意！我最喜欢这类东西了。他一定会很开心的。

lines.en: : To choose just one aspect of his person, though...hmm...
lines.zh: : 不过要从他身上只挑一个方面……嗯……

lines.en: : What I enjoy most about our teacher is his...playfulness, I suppose. At least when it comes to how he associates with me.
lines.zh: : 要说我最享受我们老师哪一点，应该是他的……爱玩吧。至少就他跟我相处的方式而言。

lines.en: : For as long as I’ve walked this earth, I’ve had what is essentially an army of servants waiting on my beck and call. Even now, I {i}still{/i} have such an army. And this is not me bragging, I assure you.
lines.zh: : 自我降生于世以来，身边就基本有一支听候差遣的仆从大军。即便到了现在，我{i}依然{/i}拥有这样一支大军。我向你保证，这不是在炫耀。

lines.en: : Sensei is the first person apart from my sister to treat me like a normal girl rather than royalty. And while that may have annoyed me before I was used to it...
lines.zh: : Sensei 是除我姐姐之外，第一个把我当普通女孩、而不是当王室成员对待的人。在我习惯之前，这或许让我有些恼火……

lines.en: : Now that I {i}am,{/i} I can’t even fathom having that taken away from me.
lines.zh: : 可如今我{i}已经习惯了{/i}，我甚至无法想象它被从我身边夺走。
{i}Touka Tsukioka 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : My favorite thing...is what he has {i}seen.{/i} What he has {i}felt.{/i} As everything you and I will ever experience is little more than an echo peeling off of his flesh.
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢的一点……是他{i}所见过的{/i}。他{i}所感受过的{/i}。因为你我所经历的一切，都不过是从他血肉上剥落的回声。

lines.en: : The amount of people who are truly {i}gifted{/i} is dwindling by the day. And from the moment I met him, I could tell he was special.
lines.zh: : 真正{i}天赋异禀{/i}的人正在日渐稀少。而从我遇见他的那一刻起，我就看得出他很特别。

lines.en: : He has what it takes to fix this world. How very sad it is that he’s yet to {i}embrace{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 他拥有修复这个世界的资质。可他至今仍未{i}接纳{/i}它，这是多么令人悲伤。

lines.en: : But that day will come. And when it does, you’ll be happy I led him to the light.
lines.zh: : 但那一天终将到来。而到了那时，你会庆幸是我把他引向了光明。

lines.en: : For it will be that fateful meaning that spells out the rest of eternity and all that comes after.
lines.zh: : 因为正是那个宿命般的意义，将拼写出此后永恒、以及之后的一切。
{i}Yasu Yasui 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : I feel like I’ve waited my whole life to answer this question, but now that I’m actually being {i}asked{/i} it, I’m struggling to come up with anything.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己等了一辈子才等到这个问题，可现在真的被{i}问到{/i}了，我却什么也想不出来。

lines.en: : Ak- {i}ahem.{/i} Sensei’s been a major part of my life since before I could even walk. So coming up with just one thing that trumps all of the others is like...picking out a favorite blade of grass in an open field.
lines.zh: : Ak——{i}咳{/i}。早在我还不会走路的时候，Sensei 就是我生命里重要的一部分。所以要挑出一件压过所有其他的，就像……在旷野里挑一根最喜欢的草。

lines.en: : That’s probably not the best comparison I could have made, but you get what I’m saying, right?
lines.zh: : 这大概不是我能想到的最好比喻，不过你懂我的意思，对吧？

lines.en: : He’s just...he’s {i}Sensei.{/i} I wouldn’t have spent years chasing after him if he wasn’t worth chasing after.
lines.zh: : 他只是……他就是{i}Sensei{/i}。要是不值得追，我也不会追了他那么多年。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s what I like the most? Just the fact that he’s been there forever and that I’m basically just a baby duck trying to keep up with him at this point.
lines.zh: : 也许这就是我最喜欢的一点？就是他一直都在，而我现在基本上就是只努力跟上他的小鸭子。

lines.en: : And...now that I say that, I’ve realized another thing I love about him.
lines.zh: : 而且……话说到这儿，我又想到了另一件我喜欢他的地方。

lines.en: : He doesn’t {i}mind{/i} that I want to stay under his wing a little while longer...
lines.zh: : 他并不{i}介意{/i}我想在他的羽翼下再多待一会儿……

lines.en: : Even though I could probably fly whenever I want.
lines.zh: : 尽管我大概随时都能自己飞了。
{i}Noriko Nakayama 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？

lines.en: : Sure, I can tell you my favorite things about Sensei if you want. I just want to know how sexual I’m allowed to get first.
lines.zh: : 行啊，你想听的话我可以告诉你我最喜欢 Sensei 哪些地方。我只是想先知道，我能说到多色情的程度。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, that makes things a lot harder. I’m sure I can figure something out, though. It just might be a little hard since our relationship has sort of...changed a lot since it started.
lines.zh: : 哦。那可就难办多了。不过我肯定能想出点什么。只是可能有点难，因为我们之间的关系从一开始就……变了很多。

lines.en: : You know, I really only started talking to him because I knew Ayane liked him and that he got along with Miku. But I’m really glad I did because he’s actually...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我刚开始跟他搭话，纯粹是因为我知道 Ayane 喜欢他，而且他跟 Miku 处得来。但我真的很庆幸自己那么做了，因为他其实……

lines.en: : Well, let’s just say I like him a lot. And not {i}just{/i} because he’s easy to fantasize about when I’m alone in bed.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这么说吧，我很喜欢他。而且{i}不光{/i}是因为我一个人躺在床上的时候很容易拿他来幻想。

lines.en: : I like him because he makes me feel better about myself.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢他，是因为他让我对自己更有信心。

lines.en: : Maybe it’s because of the things he says to me. Maybe it’s because being around him make me feel good by comparison. Maybe it’s something else entirely. I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 也许是因为他对我说的那些话。也许是因为跟他在一起会让我相比之下自我感觉良好。也许完全是别的原因。我不知道。
: 但总之我喜欢他。

lines.en: : And he can totally knock me up if he ever wants to.
lines.zh: : 而且他要是想的话，随时可以让我怀上。
{i}Kirin Kanda 已被淘汰。{/i}
: 下一站去哪儿？
: 报告情况，Nao 警官。

lines.en: : Then it’s even worse than I thought...
lines.zh: : 那比我想的还要糟……

lines.en: : We’re going to need more cars. Call HQ and have them send out three more stat.
lines.zh: : 我们需要更多车。给总部打电话，让他们立刻再派三辆过来。

lines.en: : And be careful not to touch anything. We don’t want it to spread.
lines.zh: : 还有，小心别碰任何东西。我们不想让它扩散。

lines.en: I don’t think I’m supposed to be here right now.
lines.zh: 我觉得我现在不该在这儿。

lines.en: I should leave before I get in trouble.
lines.zh: 我得在惹上麻烦之前离开。

lines.en: : Hey, you! Citizen! What do you think you’re doing? This is a crime scene. The general public isn’t allowed in here.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你！市民！你以为你在干什么？这里是犯罪现场。普通民众不得入内。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. It won’t happen again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。不会再有下次了。

lines.en: : Exactly! By being here, you’re putting {i}yourself{/i} in danger! And that makes {i}us{/i} look bad!
lines.zh: : 没错！你待在这里，是在把{i}你自己{/i}置于危险之中！而这会让{i}我们{/i}很难堪！

lines.en: : I guess I’ll be on my way then. I’m sorry, officers.
lines.zh: : 那我这就走吧。抱歉，警官。
: 等一下，市民……
: 我闻到了违禁品的味道！
: 违禁品？什么违禁品？

lines.en: : You’ve got shampoo on you, don’t you?!
lines.zh: : 你身上带着洗发水，对不对？！

lines.en: : Yeah, but...I thought I’d need it for something.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过……我以为我做什么事的时候会用到。
: 做什么{i}什么？！{/i}犯罪吗？！
: 不，为了我的任务。

lines.en: : Your mission is over, bucko! You should have known better than to bring contraband around the two toughest officers in Paper City!
lines.zh: : 你的任务已经结束了，小子！你早该知道，别把违禁品带到纸城最强悍的两位警官面前！
: 把他给我铐起来，Nao 警官！

lines.en: I exit the dorms so the officers can finish their crime scene investigation.
lines.zh: 我离开了宿舍，好让警官们完成犯罪现场勘查。

lines.en: I shouldn’t go back there again.
lines.zh: 我不该再回那儿了。
